text:
julie_pm: Quick heads-up — during the phased rollout of the new Routing Policy UI in Console we're seeing a few customer reports where SDK requests arrive without route tags. That is causing quota attribution to flip to default buckets. Anyone else seeing this in telemetry?
cheng_eng_platform: saw one noise spike in the observability stream earlier. metrics show ~0.8% of requests missing `x-route-id` header between 10:02–10:06 UTC.
ben_devex: thanks — can you paste the raw trace ids / example request ids? want to confirm if it's a client SDK or proxy strip.
cheng_eng_platform: here's one trace id: trace-9f2b. TL;DR: request path goes through route-negotiator v2 canary, then internal-proxy v1.2. Proxy logs show header present, but redis-backed route cache returned empty -> routeless.
alex_eng: that suggests the console rollout might have an opt-in toggle that didn't set the default route policy for some tenants. When the SDK reads config it falls back to not sending route hints.
ben_devex: is this the same issue we saw in the `route-meta` v2 migration? different cause but similar symptom. I think we changed SDK behavior to only send header when `console.route_enabled` is true.
olivia_sre: production impact: billing misrep for a small number of tenants, but they'd hit quota surprises tomorrow. We should triage fast.
maria_product: customers in EU region reported 2 incidents. We need an interim mitigation before full rollback. Can we add a default route header in the proxy?
alex_eng: quick mitigation idea: proxy can synthesize a `x-route-id: default-shared` if cache miss and tenant has any reserved capacity. It's hacky but buys time.
cheng_eng_platform: deployment note — proxy change is quick but requires canary + 30min observation. Console change involves a migration call to set `route_enabled` for existing customers; that's slower.
ben_devex: SDK side — we can flip to optimistic mode: continue to emit `x-route-id` based on `console` config fetched at startup, but also include a `x-route-provenance: sdk-opt-in` header so we can filter in telemetry. Patch is small (py/js/go).
julie_pm: prioritize: 1) short-term proxy synth header (olivia + alex) 2) SDK opt-in patch with provenance header (ben) 3) console migration rollout plan (maria + cheng). olivia can you take 1? ben take 2?
olivia_sre: taking 1. I'll open a small runbook and a deploy PR.
ben_devex: taking 2. I'll coordinate Python/TS/Go patches. Plan: add header when startup config missing OR cache miss; include provenance string. Will open PRs with test vectors.
ci-bot: pipeline started: infra/proxy/synthesize-route-header #234 (canary)
cheng_eng_platform: for 3, i'll draft migration script and a console UI toggle that notifies tenants before flipping. also will add telemetry signal `route.migration.applied` to console events.
maria_product: I'll prepare customer comms for affected EU tenants and flag to account execs.
alex_eng: small note — make sure the SDK opt-in doesn't change signature of existing headers. Use `x-route-provenance` to avoid collisions. Example header payload: `x-route-id: default-shared; x-route-provenance: sdk-opt-in-v1`
ben_devex: adding unit tests: assert header present when cache miss, and telemetry filters by provenance. Also add e2e with proxy canary.
julie_pm: timeline? Olivia + Alex for proxy canary within 2 hours. Ben PRs in next 3 hours. Cheng + Maria migration plan by EOD. If anything blocks, post here and tag @julie_pm. :pray:
ben_devex: filing Python PR now: https://git.redwood/integration/py-sdk/pull/712 — includes ts/go mirrors. cc @cheng_eng_platform
olivia_sre: infra PR up: https://git.redwood/integration/proxy/pull/234 — canary scheduled in 15m. monitoring dashboards updated.
cheng_eng_platform: noticed one telemetry quirk: some old SDKs send `x-route-hint` casing weirdly (`X-Route-Id`). We'll canonicalize header check to lowercase in proxy to avoid false misses.
ben_devex: will also add a small compatibility note in changelog for next SDK patch: `clients that relied on implicit console defaults should upgrade`.
julie_pm: perfect. thanks team. keeping this thread as the rollout coordination channel.
